blocks.html: Robinsons Malls formally recently opened the newest Land Transportation Office at Robinsons Place General Trias and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas raising the bar higher on public service , specially in the province of Cavite. The ribbon-cutting rites indicate the formal opening and full operation of the LTO located at the second level of Robinsons Place GenTri and at the third level of Robinsons Place Dasmariñas. The new LTO at both malls are open on weekdays, from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and offer services addressing the public’s increasing demands for the renewal of driver’s license and application of student permits. With the opening of LTO at Robinsons Place General Trias and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, the public will be able to process their government-related transactions easily and more conveniently which is a part of Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center’s commitment of providing quality service for everyone. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center is a public service program of Robinsons Land Corporation. It is the Philippines’ first and biggest shopping center facility that brings together all the government agencies most relevant to the communities where Robinsons Malls are located. At present, there are 18 participating government agencies which are Bureau of Immigration (BI), Commission on Elections (COMELEC), Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), Department of Trade & Industry (DTI), Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), Land Registration Authority (LRA), Land Transportation Office (LTO), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Philippine Health Insurance (PHILHEALTH), Philippine Postal Corporation (PHLPost), Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag-IBIG Fund); Government Service Insurance System (GSIS)), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Social Security System (SSS), Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA), Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Authority (TIEZA); Philippine Overseas Employment Administration (POEA); and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA). There are 33 Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Centers nationwide with 6 more soon to open in Iligan, Naga, Tuguegarao, North Tacloban, Valencia and Ormoc.
